gitCommit.subject: Access wording: no business is told it is waiting for approval (2026-10-24)
gitCommit.body:
Access wording: no business is told it is waiting for approval (2026-10-24)

The owner's binding clarification: redeeming a platform-issued Owner setup code activates
the Owner at once; approval and commercial entitlement are separate; a business without a
subscription or grant is shown an accurate access-required state, never "waiting for
approval".

- Portal: the `pending` state reads "No access yet" and explains that the business has no
  active subscription or access grant yet (EN/FR/AR).
- Console: the subscription status `pending_activation` reads "No access yet" in the
  businesses list and the queue (EN/FR/AR).
- The public sign-up confirmation (`apply.done.body`) is untouched: public registration is
  closed, and the public site is out of this phase.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
